searchText: I have implemented the latest eth/69 proposal in Geth Can we figure out a timeline for testing? I think we should launch a basic devnet some time next week the clients don't need to fully utilize the new BlockRangeUpdate message to participate in this just implement the receipt and status message changes I can also just run a pruned node on Sepolia with eth/69 enabled, for interactive testing the hive eth protocol tests will also be updated for this, but note it's not super easy to test history expiry there I will just add some basic test vectors for invalid blockrangeupdate
